reasoning: Elderly users require warmth, calm, and absolute clarity. The 'Organic & Earthy' archetype in a light theme provides a non-clinical, approachable environment. We will use an ultra-high contrast execution (approaching Brutalist clarity but with warm tones) to ensure legibility without straining aging eyes.

rtl_guidelines.tailwind_logical_properties: Mandatory. Use 'ps-' (padding start), 'pe-' (padding end), 'ms-' (margin start), 'me-' (margin end) instead of 'pl', 'pr', 'ml', 'mr'.
rtl_guidelines.icons: Ensure back/forward arrows point correctly for RTL (Back is right arrow, Forward/Next is left arrow).

rules: No regular or light font weights. Everything must be semibold, bold, extrabold, or black.
Never use Inter or default generic fonts.
Ensure line-height (leading) is relaxed for body text to improve readability.

colors.contrast_rules: All text must pass WCAG AAA contrast ratio. No low-contrast placeholders or disabled states that fade out too much.

wizard_layout.container: max-w-2xl mx-auto min-h-[70vh] flex flex-col justify-center
wizard_layout.content: One or two input fields per screen MAXIMUM.

admin_dashboard_layout.card_style: Solid background, thick 2px borders, deep drop shadows.

spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: Minimum 64px height for all buttons and inputs. Use 'min-h-[64px]'.

inputs.style: Massive text inputs. min-h-[64px] text-2xl p-4 rounded-xl border-2 border-border focus:border-brand-primary focus:ring-4 focus:ring-brand-primary/20
inputs.labels: Explicit labels always visible outside the input. No floating labels.

buttons.primary: w-full min-h-[72px] bg-brand-primary text-white rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center gap-4 hover:bg-brand-primary_hover transition-colors shadow-[0_8px_0_#0F3820] active:translate-y-2 active:shadow-[0_0px_0_#0F3820]
buttons.secondary: w-full min-h-[72px] bg-transparent text-brand-primary border-4 border-brand-primary rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center gap-4

cards.style: bg-white border-2 border-border rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-sm

icons.usage: Every action or category must have an accompanying large icon for visual association.

motion.philosophy: No dizzying motion. Simple, clear transitions.
motion.wizard_transitions: Fade in and slight slide (e.g., slide from left to right for next, right to left for back in RTL).
motion.duration: Moderate (0.3s) so older eyes can follow the change.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.
accessibility.contrast: Maintain deep dark text on off-white backgrounds.

image_urls.description: Modern two-story house used for property placeholder or hero landing page section
Contemporary villa showcasing sleek architecture for default property images

instructions_to_main_agent: Build out the application using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI as necessary.
Enforce RTL layout universally (dir='rtl' on body, and Tailwind logical properties like ms-, pe-, ps-, me-).
Font must be Cairo. Use ONLY weights 600, 800, 900. No regular or light text.
Implement the 'Add Property' feature strictly as a 5-step Wizard. Do not combine steps. One or two huge fields per screen.
Authentication must support phone or email in one field, password in another field. No OTP implementation required as per constraints.
Admin Dashboard must display total properties, sold, rented, available, inquiries, latest additions, and subscription statuses.
Always apply 'data-testid' to buttons, links, inputs, and key text for automated testing.
Images for properties should use the provided placeholder URLs.
Do NOT use standard small Shadcn text sizing. Override Shadcn component text sizes to be text-xl minimum.
